summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on 30 October 2026 furnishing a routine voting rights and capital notification under UK FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The filing states that, as of 29 October 2026, issued share capital was 17,135,024,028 ordinary shares of US$0.50, with no shares held in treasury, making total voting rights 17,135,024,028. The figure serves as the denominator for FCA and Hong Kong Part XV disclosure calculations. Contact points are the investor relations and shareholder queries mailboxes; no transaction, offer, or board recommendation is present.
